The copy constructor default-constructs both vectors and then copy-assigns them; moving the copies into the member-initializer list lets them be copy-constructed directly (one allocation/copy each, no empty-then-assign overhead), which is faster for every non-empty field.

```cpp
FieldBase::FieldBase(const FieldBase &field)
    : values(field.values), stringIndexes(field.stringIndexes)
{
}

```
